finalists.label: Giant Cell Myocarditis
finalists.why: It has the most specific evidence, including high-sensitivity troponin T of 275 ng/L and extensive patchy late gadolinium enhancement in a mid-wall to epicardial distribution.

finalists.label: Inflammatory bowel disease-associated cardiomyopathy
finalists.why: It has a strong connection to the patient's recent ulcerative colitis diagnosis and high-sensitivity troponin T of 275 ng/L, with no evidence against it.

frontier_selector.why: The extensive patchy late gadolinium enhancement in a mid-wall to epicardial distribution and high-sensitivity troponin T of 275 ng/L were more decisive for Giant Cell Myocarditis.
